newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures closed for Japanese holiday.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures closed for Japanese holiday.

text.p: The SIMEX Nikkei futures market was closed for Autumnal Equinox Day in Japan on Monday. Trading will resume on Tuesday.
On Friday, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract ended near the lower end of its 230-point range at 21,150 against a previous settlement at 21,320. Volume was a skimpy 11,712 lots.
Dealers said players were reluctant to maintain open positions with Japan closed for a holiday on Monday and the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting to determine monetary policy on Tuesday.
Market players are divided on the likelihood of an interest rate hike following a mixed bag of economic data and recent comments by Fed officials.

A trader with a Japanese institution said the market showed signs of heading lower to cover a gap that was created near the 20,940 level when the Nikkei opened sharply higher after a long weekend in Japan early last week.
He said the December Nikkei could also come under some pressure from foreigners taking profits in the cash market.
